name: sema
description: Sema is a Codex-native local semantic governance layer for contract-first work across software, workflows, documents, and operational systems.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-force-exit testes/unidade/**/*.test.ts testes/integracao/**/*.test.ts
scripts.cli:testar-runtime: npm run cli:empacotar-runtime && npm run cli:testar-pacote-publico
scripts.release:preparar-publica: npm run codex:sync-entrypoint && npm run release:verificar-versao && npm run status:check && npm run repo:verificar-publico && npm run plugin:testar-codex && npm test && npm run release:verificar-drift && npm run cli:empacotar-publica && npm run cli:testar-pacote-publico
scripts.codex:sync-entrypoint: npm run build && node pacotes/cli/dist/bin.js sync-codex --json
scripts.docs:prepare: npm run status:sync && npm run status:check
scripts.project:check: npm run status:check && npm run repo:verificar-publico && npm test && npm run format:check && npm run cli:testar-runtime && node pacotes/cli/dist/bin.js verificar . --saida ./.tmp/verificacao-project-check
